_doc: Single source of truth shared by mechanical/puck.py, mechanical/blender and hardware/gen_pcb.py. Units mm. Board coordinates: origin on the puck axis, +x right, +y up, viewed from the cap (top). z = 0 at the plate face that seats on the Avalon weight.

puck.plate: 6061-T6 flat plate, laser or waterjet cut: centre hole for the bolt, 4x M2 tapped
puck.screw: M2x8 cheese head (ISO 14580, Torx) from above, through the cap, PCB and standoff into the tapped plate

_pcb_dia: Puck OD = Avalon barebow weight OD (40 mm). Cavity 37 mm (cap_wall 1.5) minus 0.5 mm clearance per side.

bosses._positions: Board x, y. H3 and H4 at r = 16.5 (305 and 226 deg). H1 (100.6 deg) and H2 (164.5 deg, r = 16.49) either side of the USB-C port, moved apart (Richard) so the ground pour reaches the port's wing tabs; the port sits midway (132.58 deg). H4 holds the left arm (PCM and cell contacts). Four screws for shot shock (README D29).
bosses._screw: The counterbore depth puts the screw tip tip_inset above the plate's underside, so it never touches the weight.
bosses._clamp: The bosses stop boss_gap above the PCB; an O-ring 2 x 1.0 on each M2 screw under its boss clamps the board (~35 % squeeze, ~15-55 % over the +/-0.2 mm Kapton/standoff/PCB stack) and keeps the screw captive in the cap, so the cap goes on as one unit.

seal.part: O-ring 37 x 1.0 mm (ID x cross-section), silicone (VMQ) or NBR, 70 Shore A
seal._seal: The cap wall is stepped: its inner band (cavity to ledge_od) reaches the plate and sets the gap, the outer band stops cs x (1 - squeeze) above it. The O-ring stretches ~2 % onto the ledge, so it stays on the cap during assembly, and is squeezed 25 % between the outer band and the flat plate. The cap wall and the sleeve both seat on the plate.

cell.part: LIR1254 Li-ion coin cell, plain (no tabs), 3.6-3.7 V, 45-65 mAh
cell._swell: No swell spec for LIR cells: 1.2 mm free above the 5.4 mm cell (Varta asks 1.5 mm for its cells), set so the connector is flush with the cap top. The cap's foam pad fills it and clamps the cell.
cell._contacts: + : spring contact from pos_pad against the can side. - : strap from neg_pad across the top cap, Kapton where it passes the can. The cap's foam pad presses the strap and the cell onto the Kapton on the plate.

module._rot: Long axis tangential to the rim, slid 45 deg clockwise around the sleeve from the top (centre at r = 11.0) so the left side is free for the USB-C port: both outer corners 0.24 mm inside the rim, body 0.9 mm above the tube, as at the top. The antenna end points 45 deg below +x; everything right of the tube is copper-free (board_shape.rf_keepout). mass_g is an estimate (not in the data sheet): weigh the part.

connector.part: SHOU HAN TYPE-C 6PFS 2JCB1.6-H6.7 IPX8, waterproof USB-C 6P power-only, recessed into a board-edge notch (LCSC C3020041)
connector._note: x, y, rot_deg: footprint origin and rotation (KiCad J1); the plug axis is radial at 132.58 deg. Lengths along the plug axis are measured forward from the footprint origin (body_back = rear of the body at the notch's back edge, ring_back and face = rear and front of the silicone ring), heights from the board top (mouth_z = centre of the ring and mouth); from the datasheet and LCSC's STEP model (ShotPuck.3dshapes, aligned by its pins). The ring (10.44 x 4.66 x 0.95) seals radially in a hole in the cap wall, squeezed seal_squeeze per side; the cap has a flat at the receptacle face so any plug up to the Type-C overmold maximum (overmold_*) seats fully, and a pocket in its ceiling over the body. mass_g is an estimate.

bolt.head: button head socket cap screw, 3/16 in hex
bolt._note: The Avalon weight bolt as a button head, longer by the puck height plus the sealing washer: it goes through the cap top, the sleeve and the weight into the riser. Bonded sealing washer under the head.

sleeve._note: One loose tube from the plate through the Kapton and the PCB to the underside of the cap top, where a lip under the cap locates it; the plate and the cap trap it, so it cannot fall out. The bolt clamps the PC cap top onto the tube: PC is in the clamp path (Richard's prototype test, README D21). The PCB hole (od + 2 x pcb_clear) is merged with the cell notch by a straight slot; the right half of the board reaches the rest only across the top. The tube can turn, so the Kapton tape goes all round it from the plate to the cell top.

standoffs.part: M2 round spacer, 3 mm long, OD 4 mm, aluminium
standoffs._note: One under the PCB at each screw; OD within the copper-free boss ring (3.8 + 2 x 0.3 mm) on both layers.
